pages.title: 昆虫培育
pages.text: $(thing)type: flavor_immersed_daily_argo:insect_breeding$()$(br2)字段：$(br)$(li)$(thing)feed$()：饲料，$(thing)item$() 或 $(thing)tag$()$(br)$(li)$(thing)carrier$()：载体方块/物品$(br)$(li)$(thing)offspring_input$()：放进培育箱的卵$(br)$(li)$(thing)offspring_output$()：$(thing)id$() + $(thing)count$()$(br)$(li)$(thing)time$()：耗时（tick）

pages.title: 淤泥养殖
pages.text: $(thing)type: flavor_immersed_daily_argo:river_silt_farming$()$(br2)字段：$(br)$(li)$(thing)input$()：$(thing)item$()，放进去的苗种$(br)$(li)$(thing)result$()：$(thing)id$() + $(thing)count$()$(br)$(li)$(thing)time$()：成熟所需 tick$(br2)示例：鲍鱼苗 3600 tick（3 分钟）后收获 3 只鲍鱼。

pages.title: 锅具烹饪
pages.text: $(thing)type: fidworkblock:cooking$()（由前置模组提供）$(br2)字段：$(br)$(li)$(thing)appliance$()：$(thing)pot$() / $(thing)pressurecooker$() / $(thing)steambox$()$(br)$(li)$(thing)ingredients$()：材料数组，每项 $(thing)item$() 或 $(thing)tag$()$(br)$(li)$(thing)result$()：$(thing)id$() + $(thing)count$()$(br)$(li)$(thing)cookingTime$()：耗时（tick）

pages.title: 锅具示例
pages.text: $(br){"type": "fidworkblock:cooking",$(br)"appliance": "pot",$(br)"ingredients": [$(br)  {"item": "flavor_immersed_daily_argo:raw_lobster"},$(br)  {"item": "flavor_immersed_daily:tidywater"}$(br)],$(br)"result": {"id": "flavor_immersed_daily_argo:steamed_lobster", "count": 1},$(br)"cookingTime": 120}$(br2)同一个配方可以按三种锅各写一份，改 $(thing)appliance$() 与 $(thing)cookingTime$() 即可。
